GD joint gate ablation.batch_hashes: shape_test_batches.csv includes the 21 independently checked per-NPZ SHA-256 values for GD no_familiarity.

local_extracts.shape_test_batches.csv: Original columns, filtered to phase=test, shape protocols and chain=1 (S100 for naive). Each row identifies its archived per-batch NPZ and SHA-256. This file includes the separate GD run with both familiarity checks removed.
local_extracts.familiarity_test_episodes.csv: All records from the archive preview, UTF-8 / LF. These three arms provide independent episode-level checks on the batch totals.
local_extracts.reference_test_episodes.csv: Historical per-episode table limited to method=ours, unit=s100 or s100b; s100b is the separate CEM repeat.
local_extracts.gd_joint_test_episodes.csv: All 1,050 held-out GD no_familiarity episodes re-extracted from successes and action_len in 21 test NPZ files in package 06. Each member SHA-256 was checked. The episode index is its row in the original 50-episode batch. Failed episodes count as 30 replans.

held_out_protocol: One learned state per ablation arm; 3 seeds x 7 shapes x 50 episodes. Full GD and CEM use s100, with the separate CEM s100b repeat retained. Mean MPC replans covers all episodes (failures count as 30).

visual_slow_lr_comparison.metric: All seven PushT conditions, including original T
visual_slow_lr_comparison.unit: 3 learned states x 3 held-out seeds x 7 visual conditions x 50 episodes
